body: Replaced the S170-46 ambient-pressure territory model with a real Arathi Basin-style channel capture: exclusive presence starts/continues a channel, a node flips neutral the instant a channel starts (not on completion), interrupts (mixed presence, Pizza's corruption, damage taken, or the channeling team leaving) lose all progress with no free revert. Stealth (Frog's R) lets a lone capper channel undetected through a crowd of visible enemies, but starting the channel breaks that stealth, and damage to the channeling team interrupts it -- both matching real WoW Arathi Basin rules exactly, per direct founder specification. Added territorial jungle creeps (one per node, re-rolled from current owner on respawn, two flavors with genuinely different rewards -- contested = big capture swing, owned = heal-or-flip-assist depending who kills it, a real counter to turtling comps). Activated real WOTAN stats tracking for the persistent bot pool (was silently on self-minted tickets all session due to a missing env var export) and gave bots memorable display names via a new --index flag. 28 new headless tests (251 total). Verified live: a full ~2.5-minute 20-hero match ran to completion on the redesigned system without crashing; confirmed real named player identities registering and the leaderboard accumulating real stats. REDGARDEN 2cf6cdd.
title: Arathi Basin channel capture + jungle creeps + bot names
